title: Claims Bulletin: Storage Days During the Appraisal Wait on Assigned Repair Payments
content:
**Rule.** Under the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision), the storage days of an assigned repair payment follow what kept the vehicle at the repair facility:
- **Glass loss.** No storage days, since a glass replacement does not hold the vehicle for the appraisal.
- **Towed in.** When the loss is not a glass loss and a tow and storage payment stands on the claim, the vehicle was towed in and could not be taken home. Every day of the appraisal wait beyond 5 free appraisal days counts, never below zero, with no allowance limit.
- **Driven in.** Otherwise, for a vehicle driven in on any other loss, the days of the appraisal wait beyond 5 free appraisal days count, never below zero and never more than a storage-day allowance of 5 days.

**The appraisal wait** is counted in calendar days from the date the coverage confirmation was recorded on the claim to the date of the claim's first estimate (estimate sequence one). The first estimate's date is counted and the confirmation date is not. The wait is zero days when either date is missing.

### Basis questions

**What counts as towed in?** The test is whether a tow and storage payment stands on the claim's payment ledger.

**Hypothetically, a weather loss with a 12-day appraisal wait and a tow and storage payment on the claim: how many storage days?** 12 less 5 is 7 storage days, all of them, because a towed-in vehicle has no allowance limit.

**The same loss and wait, but the vehicle was driven in?** 7 days beyond the free days, limited to the 5-day allowance, gives 5 storage days.

**The same 12-day wait on a glass replacement?** No storage days.

**An appraisal wait of exactly 5 days on a non-glass loss?** No days beyond the free days, so 0 storage days whether the vehicle was towed in or driven in.

| Loss | Tow and storage payment on the claim | Storage days |
|---|---|---|
| Glass | Either | 0 |
| Other than glass | Yes | Appraisal wait less 5, never below 0, no limit |
| Other than glass | No | Appraisal wait less 5, never below 0, at most 5 |
